The most likely culprit is the output mirror device **M5**. Its drain sits on the high-impedance `vref` node, so its drain-source voltage and channel-length modulation dominate the supply sensitivity. That fits the line-regulation failure (0.1145 V/V against a 0.029 V/V limit) while vref, power, and start-up still pass. The same logic points to R2 and M4 as the next suspects: R2 sets the output-branch current and its sensitivity, and M4 sets the Vds matching against M5.
